loop.title: Three simple steps, endless strategy
loop.subtitle: Grow an empire with a single command — no complicated controls

build.title: Buy land & build factories
build.description: Buy land with server currency and place T1–T3 factories in its slots. Special slots grant bonuses.

produce.title: Automatic production
produce.description: Factories produce materials around the clock. Each upgrade raises output exponentially.

trade.title: Market trading
trade.description: Buy and sell materials on the global market to maximize profit. Prices move in real time with supply and demand.

factories.title: 11 factories across 3 tiers
factories.subtitle: From raw extraction to finished goods — build a vertically integrated empire

t1.label: Raw extraction
t1.desc: Basic factories that gather natural resources

t2.label: Primary processing
t2.desc: Turns T1 raw materials into processed goods

t3.label: Finished goods
t3.desc: High-value finished goods from T2 materials (2×2 slots)

economy.title: A living economy
economy.subtitle: The Idle Factory market is not a static shop. Player production and trades move prices, and each server's credit rating feeds back into productivity.

market.title: Supply-driven prices
market.desc: Prices fall as output rises and climb as goods grow scarce. Reading the market is how you win.

invest.title: Stocks & investing
invest.desc: Can't produce a material yourself? Buy shares in a factory that does and collect a cut of its profit.

server.title: Server credit
server.desc: A server-wide production multiplier. The more active your players, the more every factory produces.

login.subtitle: Sign in with Discord to manage your factories

access_denied.title: You cancelled the sign-in
access_denied.description: You declined access on the Discord consent screen. Granting permission is required to continue. Use the button below to sign in again.

account_already_linked_to_different_user.title: This Discord account is already linked elsewhere
account_already_linked_to_different_user.description: This Discord account is linked to a different user. If it is really yours, sign in with the existing account or get in touch.

banned.title: This account is suspended
banned.description: This account has been banned from the service. If you believe this is a mistake, please contact an operator.

client_disabled.title: This application has been disabled
client_disabled.description: The Discord application is currently deactivated. This is not something you can fix — please let an operator know.

email_doesnt_match.title: The email addresses do not match
email_doesnt_match.description: The email on the Discord account you are linking differs from the signed-in account. Try again with an account that uses the same email.

email_is_missing.title: Your Discord account has no email
email_is_missing.description: An email address is required to sign up. Add and verify an email in your Discord account settings, then try again.

email_not_found.title: Could not read your email
email_not_found.description: We could not retrieve an email address from your Discord account. Check that the account has a verified email, then try again.

internal_server_error.title: A server error occurred
internal_server_error.description: Something unexpected went wrong while processing the sign-in. Please try again shortly.

invalid_callback_request.title: Invalid callback request
invalid_callback_request.description: The request that came back from Discord was not correctly formed. Please start the sign-in over. Use the button below to sign in again.

invalid_client.title: This service's Discord credentials are invalid
invalid_client.description: Discord rejected this service's client ID or secret. The credentials have expired or are misconfigured. This is not something you can fix — please let an operator know.

invalid_code.title: The authorization code is not valid
invalid_code.description: The authorization code has already been used or has expired. This happens when the same link is reopened via back or refresh. Use the button below to sign in again.

invalid_payload.title: The authentication data is corrupted
invalid_payload.description: The authentication data returned by Discord could not be parsed. Use the button below to sign in again.

invalid_profile.title: The profile format could not be parsed
invalid_profile.description: Your Discord account information is not in the expected shape. If this repeats, please get in touch.

invalid_redirect_uri.title: The redirect address is not registered
invalid_redirect_uri.description: The address you would return to after signing in does not match the list registered on the Discord application. This is not something you can fix — please let an operator know.

invalid_request.title: The sign-in request was malformed
invalid_request.description: A required value was missing or wrongly formatted. If you edited the link in the address bar, start over from the beginning. Use the button below to sign in again.

invalid_scope.title: The requested permission scope is invalid
invalid_scope.description: The permission scope this service asked Discord for is not valid. This is not something you can fix — please let an operator know.

invalid_token.title: Invalid token
invalid_token.description: The authentication token is not valid — the link was tampered with or has already been used. Use the button below to sign in again.

invalid_user.title: Invalid user
invalid_user.description: The user in the request could not be verified. Sign in again, then retry.

missing_profile.title: No profile information
missing_profile.description: Sign-up cannot proceed without your Discord account information. Please try again shortly.

name_is_missing.title: Your Discord account has no display name
name_is_missing.description: A display name is required to sign up. Check your Discord profile, then try again.

no_callback_url.title: No return address was given
no_callback_url.description: The request did not include an address to go to after signing in. This is not something you can fix — please let an operator know.

no_code.title: No authorization code was delivered
no_code.description: Discord came back without an authorization code. This usually happens when the sign-in window is closed midway. Use the button below to sign in again.

oauth_code_verification_failed.title: Authorization code verification failed
oauth_code_verification_failed.description: The security verification (PKCE) value did not match. This happens when sign-in starts in one browser and finishes in another. In the same browser, use the button below to sign in again.

oauth_provider_not_found.title: Sign-in provider not found
oauth_provider_not_found.description: The requested social sign-in provider is not configured on this service. This is not something you can fix — please let an operator know.

payload_expired.title: The authentication request expired
payload_expired.description: The sign-in request passed its validity window. Use the button below to sign in again.

please_restart_the_process.title: Please start the sign-in over
please_restart_the_process.description: No in-progress authentication data remains — too much time passed, or cookies were cleared. Use the button below to sign in again.

server_error.title: Discord returned an error
server_error.description: Discord's authentication server returned an error. This is not a problem on our side — please try again shortly.

signup_disabled.title: New sign-ups are closed right now
signup_disabled.description: Creating new accounts is currently paused. If you already have an account, sign in with it instead.

state_mismatch.title: Security verification failed
state_mismatch.description: The anti-forgery state value did not match. This happens when cookies are blocked or the sign-in window was left open too long. Allow cookies, then use the button below to sign in again.

temporarily_unavailable.title: Discord is temporarily unresponsive
temporarily_unavailable.description: Discord's authentication servers are overloaded or under maintenance. Please try again in a few minutes.

token_expired.title: The sign-in link expired
token_expired.description: The token passed its validity window. Use the button below to sign in again.

unable_to_get_user_info.title: Could not fetch your Discord profile
unable_to_get_user_info.description: Reading your account information from Discord failed. If it keeps happening after a retry, please get in touch.

unable_to_link_account.title: Could not link the account
unable_to_link_account.description: Linking your Discord account to an existing account failed. Please try again shortly.

unauthorized_client.title: This application is not allowed to sign you in
unauthorized_client.description: The Discord application is configured to disallow this sign-in method. This is not something you can fix — please let an operator know.

unknown.title: Sign-in failed
unknown.description: Authentication did not complete for an unknown reason. Please try again shortly. If you keep seeing this screen, get in touch and include the code below.

unsupported_response_type.title: Unsupported authentication method
unsupported_response_type.description: Discord rejected the shape of the authentication request this service sent. This is not something you can fix — please let an operator know.

user_creation_failed.title: Could not create your account
user_creation_failed.description: An error occurred while creating a new account. If a retry does not help, please get in touch.

user_info_is_missing.title: Your Discord profile came back empty
user_info_is_missing.description: Discord returned no account information. Please try again shortly.

user_not_found.title: User not found
user_not_found.description: No matching account exists — it may have been deleted. Please sign in again.
